[quote=shahban;60977915][b]Statement from the Shahbani Office of Foreign Relations[/b]

Greater Tirakans decision to reclassify Shahbani exports under enhanced controls is not a neutral technical measure, regardless of how it is described.
When administrative barriers are introduced immediately after a political disagreement, they cease to be tools of caution and become instruments of greed. 
Let us make clear that Shahban has not withdrawn from dialogue.
The invocation of external humanitarian crises to justify economic measures against Shahban is inappropriate and an unnecessary escalation.
In response to Tirakans actions, and to show that we will not be toyed with, Shahban will temporarily suspend all pending export certifications for strategic minerals destined for markets that apply predatory controls.
Shahban remains committed to stability and respect.

~ Office of the High Emir[/quote]

[b]Statement posted on AntaGram from Acting Premier Arlan Vos[/b]

Shahbans suspension of strategic exports is a deliberate act of economic coercion. Greater Tirakan will not accept supply manipulation disguised as diplomacy. After several days of back and forth of economical escalation, we draw the line here. We have never intended to take measures like these, but the new republic will not be disrespected like that.

Effective immediately, all Shahbani owned, Shahbani controlled, or Shahbani affiliated assets operating within Greater Tirakans jurisdiction are placed under state administration pending investigation into their role in harmful trade practices. Access to Tirakans ports, transit routes, and markets will be restricted accordingly.
Strategic materials currently in transit through Tiraki infrastructure will not be released until Shahban reverses its unilateral export suspension and returns to reasonable trade standards.

Greater Tirakan is prepared to act decisively. And so we have done. The choice to de-escalate lies with Shahban.

[spoiler=[b]Corporate Withdrawal: Erene 2000[/b]]

The Zaibatsu, four conglomerates originating from UREV, discussed recent developments in their shared Valdderan economic project, and concerning information regarding the government's violation of their shared contract. The Zaibatsu learned that the Valdderan government was planning on violating and minimising Zaibatsu control over the economy, directly going against the terms of the contract and the interests of the Zaibatsu. It had become clear to them, Valddera was no longer a trustworthy entity to operate in.

Corporate security forces from the Antonio Consortium and Terran Industries were quickly mobilised towards key businesses and infrastructure; corporate headquarters, factory complexes, power & water stations, or even entertainment buildings stadiums and television sets. The corporate security proudly displayed their weapons among the cities of the nation, large divisions of corporate soldiers were brought in and given full permission by the Valdderan government to operate in the nation, initially to combat antigovernmental forces then to maintain stability in the war torn regions. Local police were confronted by corporate owned APCs and equipped troops, losing control over the situation around corporate controlled property and assets.

Once security was guaranteed, the corporations began mass-selling all the subsidiary businesses that were bought, selling them at the same price they were purchased for to other foreign corporations or even governments, including the Valdderan one. Large sectors of the Valdderan economy shut down the Zaibatsu stopped operations and went into overtime to remove all assets which would be sent back to UREV. Thousands of people would find themselves jobless as their place of work shut down and went into listing, while the corporations took their money and property, loading them onto large cargo and freight ships to be shipped back home.

The Antonio Consortium was given a large monopoly on the water and power sector, given permission to rebuild utilities following the war with Daesun. Once they began their operation, all power and water stations were shutdown all at once, large populations instantly lost access to their utilities and many operating them were let go as the consortium wasn't planning on restarting the stations. Power and water stations which were built by the Antonio Consortium were demolish using controlled explosives or demolition vehicles, while stations that were instead bought had any moveable assets removed but otherwise were left untouched. The Antonio Consortium demolished any factories they had built while untouched those they bought, and power lines were severed to slow down any efforts to bring them back up. Factories which weren't demolished were sold off as quickly as possible. The stadium which Antonio bought ceased their renovations mid-way through, leaving the scaffolding as was and removing any assets they could, though the stadium and football team werent sold off and instead kept while the consortium made up their mind.

Terran Industries did the same, demolishing factories they built and instantly letting go thousands of local workers leading to a massive increase in unemployment in some areas reliant on manufacturing. Unfinished or unsold cars, their frames, or even as simple as headlights were marked as corporate property and shipped off towards cargo vessels to be sent to UREV, while production lines were sabotaged or entire complexes sold off as quickly as possible to other corporations such as Lagonda. Machinery produced or bought was also moved out of the country, leaving many factories as large empty husks with random parts or unmaintained machinery scattered around. Company vehicles were hurriedly shipped out of the country or sent into scrapyards to be quickly destroyed, while those very same scrapyards, owned by Antonio Consortium or Amery, were listed off to other entities.

The Orion Corporation moved their IT specialists out of the country and many locals found themselves out of IT jobs. The Orion Corporation with help from Amery funded and built many cell-towers in the nation, and once they began to leave the Valdderan population found themselves with data or WIFI, businesses losing access to their systems without proper reception and communications became difficult, forcing people to endure or move to other smaller companies as Orion managed to purchase local businesses in that sector. Cell towers which were purchased were sold off to other entities, while those built by the Orion Corporation were sabotaged or destroyed in controlled demolitions, little assets could be recovered though what could was sent back home. Broadcasting subsidiaries and television channels shutdown as operations ceased, listed to other entities and their employees fired in a single day.

Lastly, Amery Holdings sold off their construction and real estate subsidiaries and began to cease any construction projects still remaining. Any vehicles owned by Amery were loaded off into ships or sold off to local businesses, while their real estate market remained relatively unaffected by the operation, as Amery controlled the housing market through local subsidiaries which were being listed off.

The corporations kept a close eye on the Valdderan government, their corporate security barred any police involvement and maneuvered across regions to wherever the corporations were demolishing or in the process of asset removal. All investments in Valddera were quickly pulled back and back home the Zaibatsu urged other corporations to do the same, UREV feelings for Valddera took a decline across civilian and corporate opinions, while the government remained indifferent if less trusting of the Valdderans. Corporate security were tasked to ensure that Valddera would not interfere or prevent the corporations from finishing their total withdrawal, and any surplus military weapons were shipped out of the country back to UREV. The Zaibatsu decided that it was not worth remaining in Valddera, and the best course of action was to sell or demolish their property in the country.[/spoiler]
